set.body: User requests scripts that migrate/retrieve extant datasets for real-data tests, with no downloads on machines that do not opt in. Cover current pinned OASIS development inputs, optional Hodgeflow T1 fixture and existing exploratory motion fMRI inputs. Reuse current checksums/selection and preserve scientific/ownership/licensing boundaries. Provide lightweight catalog/plan/verify, explicit fetch and verified local import, shared configurable cache, atomic writes, download-size budget option and no network from build/test/list/plan/import/verify. Make known missing download provenance explicit, without inventing sources or qualifying exploratory data. Validate offline with synthetic transport/archive failures and real existing local-file imports; do not redownload large datasets to test the scripts. Document migration/test commands and keep dataset binaries ignored.
set.title: Make existing real-data inputs opt-in and portable across machines
